documents.title: Lumora sales climb
documents.text: Sales of Lumora rose from 2.0 million to 2.6 million packs in 2023, a 40% increase. The Lumora plant in Norvik employs 1,200 workers.

documents.title: Lumora's sales surge
documents.text: Sales of Lumora rose from 2.0 million to 2.6 million packs in 2023, a 40% increase, the wire reported. The Lumora plant in Norvik employs 1,200 workers.

documents.title: Correction: Lumora plant workforce
documents.text: Correction: The Lumora plant in Norvik employs 900 workers.
